summary: Summit Therapeutics Inc. filed an 8-K on June 1, 2026, disclosing press releases dated May 30 and 31, 2026, regarding new results from the AK112-206 Phase II trial and the HARMONi-6 Phase III trial for ivonescimab in metastatic colorectal cancer. The filing also includes presentation slides for a June 1 conference call. No specific deal terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics are mentioned. This is a routine clinical data update, not a special situation; therefore, no risk-arb angle applies.
